Name: Korah, Son of Esau
Summary: Korah was a son of Esau by Aholibamah, and one of the dukes of Edom.
KeyStory: Korah is named among Aholibamah's sons and among Edom's dukes — a different Korah from the rebel in Moses' day.
LifeLesson: Two men can share a name and walk very different paths; God knows each one.
